positions.title: Implementation Consultant
positions.description: As an Implementation Consultant contracted to Fast Enterprises, my job is to translate client needs into software solutions. I advise our client on all available avenues to tackle problems, and work with the client to find the best, most efficient solution.

positions.title: Teaching Assistant
positions.description: In the Spring 2019 term, I assisted in the Principles of Software Design course. I graded C++ based assignments and quizzes. The course covered material from the book "Design Patterns: Elements of Reusable Object-Oriented Software". My duty was to provide as much help to students as possible, so I held weekly recitation hours to help students understand the design patterns covered in class. For the Fall 2019 semester, I will be assisting students in the IUPUI Computing II course.

positions.title: Research IDS Intern
positions.description: Developed a proof-of-concept voice assistant for a lab setting. Designed entire architecture of the project; the technologies used were: Azure cloud, CMUSphinx, and SnipsNLU. Additionally, I made use of the command and factory patterns by defining an abstract "Skill" class, which simplified the creation/addition of various skills that the voice assistant could have.

positions.title: Python Analyst Intern
positions.description: Developed python scripts to enable automation of various financial tasks. Used Pandas (python) library to automate information extraction from Excel files. Decreased run-time of file converter script from 2 minutes to 10 seconds by utilizing multithreading and polymorphism. Used Jupyter notebooks for prototyping and facilitating future reference of scripts.

positions.title: Undergraduate Researcher
positions.description: Studied an effective way to create adversarial samples that would misclassify when tested in deep neural networks and random forests. Our work was accepted to the 11th International Symposium on Foundations & Practice of Security, and I am scheduled to travel to Montreal, Canada, to present our paper.

positions.title: STW Cybersecurity Analyst
positions.description: Report on potential system compromises, provide the information required to patch the problem, and monitor the status of these fixes.

positions.title: Software Engineer 3
positions.description: Working on the development and support of a web-application using the Ember.js framework for the front-end and Blueprint.js framework for the backend.

positions.title: Assistant Manager
positions.description: Shift manager in a Burger King restaurant. My responsibilities include, but are not limited to, customer satisfaction, training and supervision of crew, money handling, temperature monitoring, nightly paper-work, bank drops and so on.

honors.title: Top of Computer Science program
honors.description: Graduated at the top of Computer Science program in Ivy Tech, Columbus.

honors.title: 2017 Statewide IT Challenge
honors.description: Won the Gold Medal in the Computer Science category.

volunteerExperiences.description: Aided in the restoration of schools in impoverished communities. Most of the work included repainting classrooms, removal of unusable desks and repair of anything that seemed salvageable.

volunteerExperiences.companyName: Center for Earth and Environmental Science
volunteerExperiences.description: I aided in the removal of the Bush Honeysuckle invasive species from the Eagle Creek park. The Honeysuckle is a rather hardy species of bush, so its removal will remain an ongoing effort by the CEES for some time.
